results.title: Legislators and accountability: How the sausage is made
results.description: "Legislative privilege" says what it means. It is immunity for state legislators from being forced to reveal private conversations during policymaking. It is commonplace in the constitutions and statutes of states, and not unreasonable when narrowly applied.

46 KCP (Taibanganba) members lay down arms at ‘homecoming ceremony’ in Manipur
results.description: Manipur's Chief Minister Y Khemchand Singh took a momentous step as he welcomed forty-six militants who renounced their ties to the prohibited KCP (Taibanganba). In a heartfelt 'Homecoming Ceremony,' the state pledged to help these former combatants establish a stable livelihood, aligning with the modified surrender-cum-rehabilitation policy of 2018 to promote harmony and development.
